name: MissMecha
description: Incomplete data is a persistent challenge in real-world datasets, often governed by complex and unobservable missing mechanisms. Simulating missingness has become a standard approach for understanding its impact on learning and analysis. However, existing tools are fragmented, mechanism-limited, and typically focus only on numerical variables, overlooking the heterogeneous nature of real-world tabular data. We present MissMecha, an open-source Python toolkit for simulating, visualizing, and evaluating missing data under MCAR, MAR, and MNAR assumptions.
